packages.title: Stremio Origin
packages.shortDescription: Native app for Stremio addons on LG webOS TVs. Unofficial.

manifest.title: Stremio Origin
manifest.appDescription: Your own Stremio account and addons on your LG TV, in English or Arabic: artwork and full-screen trailers, the best stream in one press, styled subtitles, clean search. Unofficial.
notes: A new look: Modern: Black and gold, flat and light, with new line icons and the tabs across the top. Classic stays in Settings, Appearance, Theme.
The right episode, clean sources: Fake files, programs and sources of another episode are left out, and a pack plays the episode you opened.
Play starts sooner: The best stream is chosen as soon as a good one is there, addons answer side by side, and a real upscale joins Settings.
Safer and lighter: A smaller app that keeps to itself on your network, and takes its updates only from this project.
